     2→title: Font Optimization
     3→description: Learn how to optimize fonts in Next.js
     4→related:
     5→  title: API Reference
     6→  description: See the API Reference for the full feature set of Next.js Font
     7→  links:
     8→    - app/api-reference/components/font
     9→---
    10→
    11→The [`next/font`](/docs/app/api-reference/components/font) module automatically optimizes your fonts and removes external network requests for improved privacy and performance.
    12→
    13→It includes **built-in self-hosting** for any font file. This means you can optimally load web fonts with no layout shift.
    14→
    15→<AppOnly>
    16→
    17→To start using `next/font`, import it from [`next/font/local`](#local-fonts) or [`next/font/google`](#google-fonts), call it as a function with the appropriate options, and set the `className` of the element you want to apply the font to. For example:
    18→
    19→```tsx filename="app/layout.tsx" highlight={1,3-5,9} switcher
    20→import { Geist } from 'next/font/google'
    21→
    22→const geist = Geist({
    23→  subsets: ['latin'],
    24→})
    25→
    26→export default function Layout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
    27→  return (
    28→    <html lang="en" className={geist.className}>
    29→      <body>{children}</body>
    30→    </html>
    31→  )
    32→}
    33→```
    34→
    35→```jsx filename="app/layout.js" highlight={1,3-5,9} switcher
    36→import { Geist } from 'next/font/google'
    37→
    38→const geist = Geist({
    39→  subsets: ['latin'],
    40→})
    41→
    42→export default function Layout({ children }) {
    43→  return (
    44→    <html className={geist.className}>
    45→      <body>{children}</body>
    46→    </html>
    47→  )
    48→}
    49→```
    50→
    51→Fonts are scoped to the component they're used in. To apply a font to your entire application, add it to the [Root Layout](/docs/app/api-reference/file-conventions/layout#root-layout).
    52→
    53→</AppOnly>
    54→
    55→<PagesOnly>
    56→
    57→To start using `next/font`, import it from [`next/font/local`](#local-fonts) or [`next/font/google`](#google-fonts), call it as a function with the appropriate options, and set the `className` of the element you want to apply the font to. For example, you can apply fonts globally in your [Custom App](/docs/pages/building-your-application/routing/custom-app) (`pages/_app`):
    58→
    59→```tsx filename="pages/_app.tsx" highlight={1,4-6,10} switcher
    60→import { Geist } from 'next/font/google'
    61→import type { AppProps } from 'next/app'
    62→
    63→const geist = Geist({
    64→  subsets: ['latin'],
    65→})
    66→
    67→export default function MyApp({ Component, pageProps }: AppProps) {
    68→  return (
    69→    <main className={geist.className}>
    70→      <Component {...pageProps} />
    71→    </main>
    72→  )
    73→}
    74→```
    75→
    76→```jsx filename="pages/_app.js" highlight={1,3-5,9} switcher
    77→import { Geist } from 'next/font/google'
    78→
    79→const geist = Geist({
    80→  subsets: ['latin'],
    81→})
    82→
    83→export default function MyApp({ Component, pageProps }) {
    84→  return (
    85→    <main className={geist.className}>
    86→      <Component {...pageProps} />
    87→    </main>
    88→  )
    89→}
    90→```
    91→
    92→If you want to apply the font to the `<html>` element, you can use a [Custom Document](/docs/pages/building-your-application/routing/custom-document) (`pages/_document`):
    93→
    94→```tsx filename="pages/_document.tsx" highlight={2,4-6,10} switcher
    95→import { Html, Head, Main, NextScript } from 'next/document'
    96→import { Geist } from 'next/font/google'
    97→
    98→const geist = Geist({
    99→  subsets: ['latin'],
   100→})
   101→
   102→export default function Document() {
   103→  return (
   104→    <Html lang="en" className={geist.className}>
   105→      <Head />
   106→      <body>
   107→        <Main />
   108→        <NextScript />
   109→      </body>
   110→    </Html>
   111→  )
   112→}
   113→```
   114→
   115→```jsx filename="pages/_document.js" highlight={2,4-6,10} switcher
   116→import { Html, Head, Main, NextScript } from 'next/document'
   117→import { Geist } from 'next/font/google'
   118→
   119→const geist = Geist({
   120→  subsets: ['latin'],
   121→})
   122→
   123→export default function Document() {
   124→  return (
   125→    <Html lang="en" className={geist.className}>
   126→      <Head />
   127→      <body>
   128→        <Main />
   129→        <NextScript />
   130→      </body>
   131→    </Html>
   132→  )
   133→}
   134→```
   135→
   136→</PagesOnly>
   137→
   138→## Google fonts
   139→
   140→You can automatically self-host any Google Font. Fonts are included stored as static assets and served from the same domain as your deployment, meaning no requests are sent to Google by the browser when the user visits your site.
   141→
   142→To start using a Google Font, import your chosen font from `next/font/google`:
   143→
   144→<AppOnly>
   145→
   146→```tsx filename="app/layout.tsx" switcher
   147→import { Geist } from 'next/font/google'
   148→
   149→const geist = Geist({
   150→  subsets: ['latin'],
   151→})
   152→
   153→export default function RootLayout({
   154→  children,
   155→}: {
   156→  children: React.ReactNode
   157→}) {
   158→  return (
   159→    <html lang="en" className={geist.className}>
   160→      <body>{children}</body>
   161→    </html>
   162→  )
   163→}
   164→```
   165→
   166→```jsx filename="app/layout.js" switcher
   167→import { Geist } from 'next/font/google'
   168→
   169→const geist = Geist({
   170→  subsets: ['latin'],
   171→})
   172→
   173→export default function RootLayout({ children }) {
   174→  return (
   175→    <html lang="en" className={geist.className}>
   176→      <body>{children}</body>
   177→    </html>
   178→  )
   179→}
   180→```
   181→
   182→</AppOnly>
   183→
   184→<PagesOnly>
   185→
   186→```tsx filename="pages/_app.tsx" switcher
   187→import { Geist } from 'next/font/google'
   188→import type { AppProps } from 'next/app'
   189→
   190→const geist = Geist({
   191→  subsets: ['latin'],
   192→})
   193→
   194→export default function MyApp({ Component, pageProps }: AppProps) {
   195→  return (
   196→    <main className={geist.className}>
   197→      <Component {...pageProps} />
   198→    </main>
   199→  )
   200→}
   201→```
   202→
   203→```jsx filename="pages/_app.js" switcher
   204→import { Geist } from 'next/font/google'
   205→
   206→const geist = Geist({
   207→  subsets: ['latin'],
   208→})
   209→
   210→export default function MyApp({ Component, pageProps }) {
   211→  return (
   212→    <main className={geist.className}>
   213→      <Component {...pageProps} />
   214→    </main>
   215→  )
   216→}
   217→```
   218→
   219→</PagesOnly>
   220→
   221→We recommend using [variable fonts](https://fonts.google.com/variablefonts) for the best performance and flexibility. But if you can't use a variable font, you will need to specify a weight:
   222→
   223→<AppOnly>
   224→
   225→```tsx filename="app/layout.tsx" highlight={4} switcher
   226→import { Roboto } from 'next/font/google'
   227→
   228→const roboto = Roboto({
   229→  weight: '400',
   230→  subsets: ['latin'],
   231→})
   232→
   233→export default function RootLayout({
   234→  children,
   235→}: {
   236→  children: React.ReactNode
   237→}) {
   238→  return (
   239→    <html lang="en" className={roboto.className}>
   240→      <body>{children}</body>
   241→    </html>
   242→  )
   243→}
   244→```
   245→
   246→```jsx filename="app/layout.js"  highlight={4} switcher
   247→import { Roboto } from 'next/font/google'
   248→
   249→const roboto = Roboto({
   250→  weight: '400',
   251→  subsets: ['latin'],
   252→})
   253→
   254→export default function RootLayout({ children }) {
   255→  return (
   256→    <html lang="en" className={roboto.className}>
   257→      <body>{children}</body>
   258→    </html>
   259→  )
   260→}
   261→```
   262→
   263→</AppOnly>
   264→
   265→<PagesOnly>
   266→
   267→```tsx filename="pages/_app.tsx" highlight={5} switcher
   268→import { Roboto } from 'next/font/google'
   269→import type { AppProps } from 'next/app'
   270→
   271→const roboto = Roboto({
   272→  weight: '400',
   273→  subsets: ['latin'],
   274→})

   279→      <Component {...pageProps} />
   280→    </main>
   281→  )
   282→}
   283→```
   284→
   285→```jsx filename="pages/_app.js" highlight={4} switcher

   302→</PagesOnly>
   303→
   304→## Local fonts
   305→
   306→<AppOnly>
   307→
   308→To use a local font, import your font from `next/font/local` and specify the [`src`](/docs/app/api-reference/components/font#src) of your local font file. Fonts can be stored in the [`public`](/docs/app/api-reference/file-conventions/public-folder) folder or co-located inside the `app` folder. For example:
   309→
   310→```tsx filename="app/layout.tsx" switcher
   311→import localFont from 'next/font/local'
   312→
   313→const myFont = localFont({
   314→  src: './my-font.woff2',
   315→})
   316→
   317→export default function RootLayout({
   318→  children,
   319→}: {
   320→  children: React.ReactNode
   321→}) {
   322→  return (
   323→    <html lang="en" className={myFont.className}>
   324→      <body>{children}</body>
   325→    </html>
   326→  )
   327→}
   328→```
   329→
   330→```jsx filename="app/layout.js" switcher
   331→import localFont from 'next/font/local'
   332→
   333→const myFont = localFont({
   334→  src: './my-font.woff2',
   335→})
   336→
   337→export default function RootLayout({ children }) {
   338→  return (
   339→    <html lang="en" className={myFont.className}>
   340→      <body>{children}</body>
   341→    </html>
   342→  )
   343→}
   344→```
   345→
   346→</AppOnly>
   347→
   348→<PagesOnly>
   349→
   350→To use a local font, import your font from `next/font/local` and specify the [`src`](/docs/pages/api-reference/components/font#src) of your local font file. Fonts can be stored in the [`public`](/docs/pages/api-reference/file-conventions/public-folder) folder or inside the `pages` folder. For example:
   351→
   352→```tsx filename="pages/_app.tsx" switcher
   353→import localFont from 'next/font/local'
   354→import type { AppProps } from 'next/app'
   355→
   356→const myFont = localFont({
   357→  src: './my-font.woff2',
   358→})
   359→
   360→export default function MyApp({ Component, pageProps }: AppProps) {
   361→  return (
   362→    <main className={myFont.className}>
   363→      <Component {...pageProps} />
   364→    </main>
   365→  )
   366→}
   367→```
   368→
   369→```jsx filename="pages/_app.js" switcher
   370→import localFont from 'next/font/local'
   371→
   372→const myFont = localFont({
   373→  src: './my-font.woff2',
   374→})
   375→
   376→export default function MyApp({ Component, pageProps }) {
   377→  return (
   378→    <main className={myFont.className}>
   379→      <Component {...pageProps} />
   380→    </main>
   381→  )
   382→}
   383→```
   384→
   385→</PagesOnly>
   386→
   387→If you want to use multiple files for a single font family, `src` can be an array:
   388→
   389→```js
   390→const roboto = localFont({
   391→  src: [
   392→    {
   393→      path: './Roboto-Regular.woff2',
   394→      weight: '400',
   395→      style: 'normal',
   396→    },
   397→    {
   398→      path: './Roboto-Italic.woff2',
   399→      weight: '400',
   400→      style: 'italic',
   401→    },
   402→    {
   403→      path: './Roboto-Bold.woff2',
   404→      weight: '700',
   405→      style: 'normal',
   406→    },
   407→    {
   408→      path: './Roboto-BoldItalic.woff2',
   409→      weight: '700',
   410→      style: 'italic',
   411→    },
   412→  ],
   413→})
   414→```
